1	# Creating a command
2	
3	Commands are declared with `defineCommand`, `defineOption` and `defineArgument`, on top of `cliparse`. Options and arguments are validated and parsed by [Zod](https://zod.dev) schemas, and their types flow into the handler. The reasons behind this design are explained in [ADR 0001](../adr/adr-0001-rework-file-structure.md).
4	
5	Before writing a command, look at a similar one and copy its naming, file layout, output format and error messages. `src/commands/drain/` is a good example of a command group with shared arguments and options.
6	
7	## Example
8	
9	A fictional `clever coffee brew <blend>` subcommand, part of a `coffee` group (neither exists in the CLI). The `<blend>` argument is shared by several `coffee` subcommands, so it lives in `coffee.args.js`:
10	
11	```js
12	// src/commands/coffee/coffee.args.js
13	import { z } from 'zod';
14	import { defineArgument } from '../../lib/define-argument.js';
15	
16	export const blendArg = defineArgument({
17	  schema: z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9-]+$/, 'Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes'),
18	  description: 'Blend of coffee',
19	  placeholder: 'blend',
20	});
21	```
22	
23	`--shots`, `--milk` and `--topping` are only used by this subcommand, so they are defined inline. `--format` comes from `global.options.js`:
24	
25	```js
26	// src/commands/coffee/coffee.brew.command.js
27	import { z } from 'zod';
28	import { brewCoffee } from '../../clever-client/coffee.js';
29	import { defineCommand } from '../../lib/define-command.js';
30	import { defineOption } from '../../lib/define-option.js';
31	import { Logger } from '../../logger.js';
32	import { sendToApi } from '../../models/send-to-api.js';
33	import { humanJsonOutputFormatOption } from '../global.options.js';
34	import { blendArg } from './coffee.args.js';
35	
36	export const coffeeBrewCommand = defineCommand({
37	  description: 'Brew a coffee',
38	  since: null,
39	  options: {
40	    shots: defineOption({
41	      name: 'shots',
42	      schema: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(4).default(1),
43	      description: 'Number of espresso shots',
44	      aliases: ['s'],
45	      placeholder: 'shots',
46	    }),
47	    milk: defineOption({
48	      name: 'milk',
49	      schema: z.enum(['none', 'whole', 'oat']).default('none'),
50	      description: 'Kind of milk',
51	      placeholder: 'milk',
52	    }),
53	    toppings: defineOption({
54	      name: 'topping',
55	      schema: z
56	        .union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())])
57	        .transform((value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? [value] : value))
58	        .optional(),
59	      description: 'Topping to add. Multiple --topping can be passed',
60	      placeholder: 'topping',
61	    }),
62	    format: humanJsonOutputFormatOption,
63	  },
64	  args: [blendArg],
65	  async handler(options, blend) {
66	    const { shots, milk, toppings, format } = options;

?? src/commands/oauth-consumers/

I added the `clever oauth-consumers` group with list (the bare command), `get`, `create`, `update`, `delete` and `open`. `npm run fix-all` and `npm run validate` pass, and `node bin/clever.js oauth-consumers --help` shows the new commands. I haven't run any of them against the API, so none of the request or response handling has been exercised.

- **Subcommands:**
  - Every subcommand takes `--org`, and `get`, `update`, `delete` and `open` take a `<consumer-key>` argument.
  - `get` has `--with-secret`, which also prints the secret (it's off by default).
  - `create` takes `<consumer-name>` plus `--description`, `--url`, `--base-url`, `--picture` and `--rights`.
  - `update` takes the same options plus `--name`. It fetches the consumer first and only changes what you pass.
  - `delete` asks for confirmation and accepts `--yes`.
  - Every new command has `since: null`.
- **No new API code:** the client library already has the consumer endpoints, so nothing was added to `src/clever-client/`.
- **Generated files:** the generated docs and `src/commands/README.md` are regenerated. `SKILL.md` doesn't mention the neighbouring commands such as `tokens`, so I left it alone.

Things I couldn't check:
- **Request body:** I couldn't check the exact fields the API expects. I assumed `name`, `description`, `url`, `baseUrl`, `picture` and `rights` as an object of booleans, e.g. `{ access_organisations: true }`. `--rights` is free-form (comma-separated) rather than a fixed list, so a wrong right name won't be caught by the CLI.
- **Console URL:** `open` goes to `/users/me/oauth-consumers/<key>`, or `/organisations/<id>/oauth-consumers/<key>` with `--org`. I guessed that path.
- **Secret response:** `get --with-secret` accepts the secret endpoint returning either a plain string or `{ secret }`.

Please try `create`, `get --with-secret` and `open` on a test account before merging. AGENTS.md says to check `clever profile` first for anything that writes, and I haven't done that.

I didn't commit. `fix-all` also reformatted `.claude/settings.json`, which isn't part of this change, so I reverted it. Per AGENTS.md this needs an issue and a PR with `Closes #N`, and the commit message would be `feat(oauth-consumers): add oauth-consumers command group`.
